notes: TITLE WITHHELD: published title '@#$% Down' is a censored swear word; page uses dest_title 'Clint Hays Hunt Down DS' because '1999 Decipher World Championship Clint Hays DS' already exists (the Trandosite 'Hays' Hunt Down' list).
Total 60 as published. Section headers ('Unknown Type', 'Characters (16)' etc.) are not cards; the objective was posted under the second 'Unknown Type' header.

This DeckTech list differs from the Trandosite list at [[1999 Decipher World Championship Clint Hays DS]] / Steven Lewis's Decipher list: it has DS-61-4, IG-88 With Riot Gun and Boba Fett In Slave I, 2 Torture (not 3) and 1 Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (not 2), and no Admiral Motti. Dested as posted.

Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are the Special Edition Effects (not the Reflections III shields). Bare 'Coruscant', 'Kashyyyk', 'Endor', 'Endor Back Door', 'Cloud City Downtown Plaza' are the Dark site/system pages.
Posted 'Bossk In Hounds Tooth' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Hoth Ice Plains' Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker).

Reposted Worlds 1999 list (Hays 5th, Steven Lewis 2nd per the post); the played list is already on [[1999 Decipher World Championship Clint Hays DS]] from the Trandosite, and this repost differs by a few cards, so it is filed as a general list.
player_note: The post (7 February 2001) says: 'This is the deck Steven Lewis and I used to get 2nd and 5th place, respectively, at worlds 99' and that it 'was made before worlds 99. it has not been updated.' It is a repost, at Neal's request, of a version purged from DeckTech.
